task.description:
Design tests for OIDC-08 (Standard claim mapping). Read the requirement at docs/BPM_Platform_Functional_Requirements.md around line 1532, the design at src/design/oidc-08-standard-claim-mapping.md, and the implementation at src/oidc/claim_mapping.zig.

Write test spec at tests/specs/OIDC-08.md and test code covering the following acceptance criteria:

AC1: Tokens from different configured providers produce equivalent internal user contexts.
- Write unit tests using identityContextsEquivalent() to verify that two IdentityContext values with the same (external_user_id, realm) are equivalent even if display_name or email differ
- Write integration tests storing per-realm configs via the migration and loading via loadClaimMappingConfig()

AC2: Claim mapping rules are configurable per realm and stored in platform configuration.
- Write integration test inserting a row into realm_claim_mapping_config, loading it, verifying non-default paths are used
- Write integration test with no config row (null returned), verifying defaults apply

AC3: Missing optional claims produce concrete defaults, not errors.
- Write unit tests for missing email → empty string
- Write unit tests for missing preferred_username → sub value
- Write unit tests for missing roles → empty list
- Write unit tests for sub claim missing → error (not default)
- Write unit tests for nested role paths (realm_access.roles)

All integration tests connect to real PostgreSQL via BPM_TEST_DB_URL. No mocks, no stubs. Every MUST requirement has at least one test case.
acceptance_criteria: Test spec tests/specs/OIDC-08.md written with full coverage analysis
Unit tests in tests/unit/ covering pure mapping function (mapVerifiedClaims) with all default variants and edge cases
Integration tests in tests/integration/ covering config load from DB
Every MUST acceptance criterion mapped to ≥1 test case
No mocks, no stubs, no in-memory fakes — real PostgreSQL for integration tests
No error.SkipZigTest on any test covering a MUST requirement

result.summary: Designed and implemented test suite for OIDC-08 (Standard claim mapping). Created test spec (tests/specs/OIDC-08.md), 21 unit tests (tests/unit/test_oidc08_claim_mapping.zig) covering mapVerifiedClaims, identityContextsEquivalent, resolveJsonPath with all default variants and edge cases, and 3 integration tests (tests/integration/oidc08_claim_mapping_config_test.zig) for DB-backed config loading via real PostgreSQL.
